user.title: House Assistant
user.description: Heating with AI, covers and meter reading on one model of the house. Choose the modules you want to use; rooms, windows and meters are added in the House Assistant panel in the sidebar afterwards.

data_description.modules: The parts of the house House Assistant takes care of. Can be changed later under Settings > Modules.

data_description.ai_task_entity: AI task entity that reads the pictures (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or Ollama with image support). A meter can use its own one.
data_description.notify_rejected: Main switch for the notifications in Home Assistant. When they come for which meter is set at the meter under "Notifications".

shutter.title: Covers
shutter.description: Global sensors. Groups (sun directions) and windows are added afterwards in the House Assistant dashboard (sidebar).

data_description.outdoor_temperature: For the summer day and the temperature condition of every window. Without a sensor the current temperature of the weather entity is used (at least one of both).
data_description.weather: Its daily forecast decides at the day change whether today is a summer day.
data_description.language: Logbook, last reason and push messages.
data_description.notify_services: Get a message when an open window prevents sun protection (notify services only, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone).
data_description.workday_entity: Optional, for the morning opening by time (e.g. Workday integration, knows public holidays). Without a sensor the weekend days decide.
data_description.weekend_days: Only without a workday sensor: on these days the weekend time of the morning opening applies.

shutter_summer.title: Summer day
shutter_summer.description: Sun protection only runs on summer days.

data.night_threshold: Late summer day only with a night from

data_description.summer_threshold: Without a summer day there is no sun protection. During the day the summer day also starts when the outdoor temperature rises above this value (see night).
data_description.night_threshold: A summer day only by the outdoor temperature counts only when the forecast low of the coming night is at least this value. When the night cools down (spring, autumn), the warmth stays in the house. Without a low in the forecast the summer day counts as before.
data_description.heating_entity: Optional, e.g. an input_boolean "heating season" or the heating day of a heating control. While it is on, the warmth of the sun is welcome: sun protection only when the room of a window is too warm anyway. Windows without a room temperature are then not lowered.
data_description.day_change_time: Forecast check and reset of the daily sun protection markers and notifications.
data_description.forecast_type: Automatic takes the first kind the weather entity supports (daily, twice daily, hourly). From hourly values the high of the day and the low of the night are calculated.

shutter_evening.title: Evening mode
shutter_evening.description: The evening mode closes the covers once and blocks auto up. Windows can use own times.

data_description.evening_earliest: The evening mode never starts before this time.
data_description.evening_elevation: The evening mode starts when the sun drops below this elevation (e.g. -4 °).
data_description.evening_latest: Time fallback: the evening mode starts at this time at the latest.
data_description.night_end: Evening mode and evening markers end at this time (or at sunrise if that is earlier).
data_description.follow_up_earliest: A window closed in the evening closes the cover only after this time.

abort.single_instance_allowed: House Assistant is already set up. Rooms, windows and meters are added in the panel.

error.latest_before_earliest: The latest time is before the earliest one. Move the latest time later or the earliest earlier.
error.night_end_after_evening: The end of the night must be before the earliest evening start, e.g. 03:30 with an evening from 17:00.
error.min_above_max: The minimum is above the maximum. Swap or adjust the values.
error.azimuth_equal: Azimuth from and to must differ.
error.no_lux_sensor: The group of this window has no brightness sensor. Add a brightness sensor to the group or choose another mode.
error.need_temperature_source: Choose an outdoor temperature sensor or a weather entity; without a temperature there is no summer day.
error.not_numeric: This entity does not report a number. Choose a sensor with a measured value (e.g. °C, lx, W, W/m²).
error.invalid_notify_service: Only notification services (notify.…) are allowed. Choose a service from the list.
error.cover_in_use: This cover is already controlled by another window. Choose another cover or change the other window.

data_description.modules: The parts of the house House Assistant takes care of. A module switched off keeps its settings.
data_description.show_panel: Off: the dashboard disappears from the sidebar but stays reachable with "Configure" at the integration.

shutter_override.title: Manual override
shutter_override.description: When a movement by hand (switch, app, voice assistant) starts the override of a window. Duration and further settings are set per window.

data_description.override_trigger: Only with a real movement: a command to a cover already at its target (e.g. "open all" while it is open) does not start an override. Every command: also without movement, as before.

shutter_vacation.title: Vacation simulation
shutter_vacation.description: Random opening in the morning and closing in the evening while vacation is active.

data_description.vacation_entities: Vacation is active while one of them is on (e.g. an input_boolean "vacation" or a calendar).
data_description.vacation_morning_start: Closed covers of the windows in the simulation open at a random time after this.
data_description.vacation_morning_window: Each window opens at a random time within this period.
data_description.vacation_evening_start: Starts the evening for the windows in the simulation and closes them at random times. The normal evening run rests during vacation.
data_description.vacation_evening_window: Each window closes at a random time within this period.

shutter_protection.title: Weather protection
shutter_protection.description: Wind and rain move the covers of the windows that take part to their protection position, also during an override and with the automatic off. Frost keeps a gap when closing. Positions are set per window.

data_description.wind_entity: Wind speed or gusts, e.g. from a weather station.
data_description.wind_threshold: In the unit of the wind sensor (e.g. km/h or m/s).
data_description.rain_entity: A rain sensor that turns on, or an amount of rain (e.g. mm/h).
data_description.rain_threshold: Only for a numeric rain sensor: rain counts above this value.
data_description.frost_threshold: Outdoor temperature. Only windows with a frost position take part.
data_description.protection_release: A protection ends only after the value stayed on the safe side this long. An unavailable sensor never ends a protection.

data.catch_up_after: Catch up the evening run from

data_description.startup_delay: No movement for this time after Home Assistant started (sensors and covers are still coming online).
data_description.catch_up_after: After the restart protection the evening run is caught up for windows not yet closed this evening, but only after this time.

data_description.window_closed_delay: A window contact must report closed this long before closing after the window, sun protection or the close trigger act (against bouncing contacts).
data_description.command_interval: Several covers move one after the other with this spacing (against radio collisions). 0 = all at once.
data_description.verify_after: If a cover has not reached its target by then, the command is repeated once; then a notification is sent. 0 = off.

user.title: Group
user.description: A group is a direction of the sun with its sensors. Thresholds are set per window.

data_description.name: Also used for the device and its entities.
data_description.azimuth_from: Sun direction from which the sun shines on the windows (90 ° = east, 180 ° = south, 270 ° = west). The bounds themselves do not count.
data_description.azimuth_to: When the sun reaches this direction, protected covers open again (auto up).
data_description.radiation_sensors: Solar radiation in W/m², e.g. from a weather service or a weather station.
data_description.pv_sensors: Power of a solar system or panel facing this direction (W).
data_description.lux_sensors: Lux sensors at the windows. Every sensor of the group must reach the threshold of the window.

reconfigure.title: Group
reconfigure.description: A group is a direction of the sun with its sensors. Thresholds are set per window.

data_description.name: Also used for the device and its entities.
data_description.azimuth_from: Sun direction from which the sun shines on the windows (90 ° = east, 180 ° = south, 270 ° = west). The bounds themselves do not count.
data_description.azimuth_to: When the sun reaches this direction, protected covers open again (auto up).
data_description.radiation_sensors: Solar radiation in W/m², e.g. from a weather service or a weather station.
data_description.pv_sensors: Power of a solar system or panel facing this direction (W).
data_description.lux_sensors: Lux sensors at the windows. Every sensor of the group must reach the threshold of the window.

data_description.name: Also used for the device and its entities.
data_description.window_sensors: 'on' = open. Window handles with the states open, tilted and closed work as well. Unknown or unavailable counts as open.
data_description.tilt_sensors: 'on' = tilted. While the window is only tilted, covers close no further than the ventilation position.
data_description.group: Direction of the sun. Without a group the window has no sun protection.

data.manual_at_sun_position: Moving onto the sun protection position counts

data_description.radiation_threshold: Every radiation sensor of the group must reach this value.
data_description.pv_threshold: Every PV sensor of the group must reach this value.
data_description.lux_threshold: Every brightness sensor of the group must reach this value.
data_description.temperature_threshold: Sun protection only from this outdoor temperature on.
data_description.temperature_hold: The outdoor temperature must stay above the value this long. Below it the condition ends immediately.
data_description.room_entity: Optional: thermostat (climate) or temperature sensor of the room. Then the cover is only lowered when the room is too warm. Without a value the condition counts as met (except on a heating day).
data_description.room_margin: With a thermostat: too warm from its setpoint plus this margin.
data_description.room_threshold: With a temperature sensor (or a thermostat without a setpoint): too warm from this temperature.
data_description.cooling_entity: Optional: while this air conditioner cools, the room counts as too warm. Sun protection then takes load off the air conditioner.
data_description.sun_hold: Summer day, temperature, room and all sun sensors must be met this long. The condition ends immediately.
data_description.sun_position: Lowered once a day to this position. A cover already further closed is left alone.
data_description.position_tolerance: Auto up only opens covers standing at the sun protection position up to this much above it. Covers moved elsewhere by hand stay.
data_description.auto_up: Open again when the sun leaves the sector (not in the evening).
data_description.notify_open_window: Once a day, if an open window prevented the sun protection.
data_description.manual_max_position: A cover lowered by hand to at most this position while the sun shines counts as sun protection for today (no automatic movement).
data_description.manual_detection_window: The manual movement must not be longer ago than this.
data_description.manual_follow_up: For this detection the sun condition (without temperature) still counts this long after it ended.
data_description.manual_at_sun_position: A cover moved by anyone onto the sun protection position (up to the tolerance) while the sun shines is treated like automatic sun protection and opens again with auto up.

data.override_ignore_evening: Evening and vacation runs despite override

data_description.override_duration: After a manual movement the automatic pauses this long for the window. Every further movement starts it again. 0 = until sunrise.
data_description.override_ignore_evening: e.g. bedrooms that should always close in the evening.
data_description.override_sunrise_reset: The override also ends at the next sunrise, even if the duration is still running.

data_description.open_block_entity: No automatic opening (auto up, ventilation, vacation morning, morning opening) unless this entity has one of the free states (e.g. a TV).
data_description.close_trigger_entities: When one of these entities becomes active, the cover closes once per active cycle, only with a closed window (otherwise as soon as it is closed). The cycle ends when all are inactive.
data_description.window_exception_entity: While this entity is available, an open window does not prevent closing movements and no message is sent (e.g. an air conditioner with its hose through the balcony door). Not used for the vacation evening.
data_description.open_block_free_states: States of the opening block in which opening is still allowed (e.g. off, standby).
data_description.close_trigger_active_states: States in which a close trigger counts as active (e.g. on, playing for a TV).
data_description.close_trigger_on_delay: A trigger must be active this long before the cover closes (switching on briefly does not count).
data_description.close_trigger_off_delay: All triggers must be inactive this long before the cycle ends and switching on closes again.
data_description.close_trigger_min_position: Only closes when the cover is open further than this position.
data_description.close_trigger_max_lock: After this time at the latest a new cycle starts, even if the triggers were active all the time.

data_description.evening_close: Close at the start of the evening mode, once per evening and only with a closed window.
data_description.evening_position: Target of the evening run and of closing after the window was closed. 0 % = closed; e.g. 20 % leaves a gap on warm nights.
data_description.follow_up_close: If the window is closed in the evening, the cover closes (also during an override).
data_description.evening_custom: Use the following values instead of the global ones.
data_description.evening_earliest: The evening mode never starts before this time.
data_description.evening_elevation: The evening mode starts when the sun drops below this elevation (e.g. -4 °).
data_description.evening_latest: Time fallback: the evening mode starts at this time at the latest.

data_description.ventilation: Opening the window moves a closed cover to the ventilation position (in the evening after the short delay, during the day after the long one).
data_description.closed_position: Used for ventilation and the vacation morning.
data_description.ventilation_delay_day: The window must still be open afterwards.
data_description.vacation: Take part in the random opening and closing during vacation.
data_description.ventilation_delay_evening: In the evening mode the cover moves to the ventilation position after this short time.

data_description.weather_protection: Off = wind, rain and frost never move or limit this cover, whatever the positions below say. Turn it on for every window that should take part. With the automatic off (globally or for this window) there is no weather protection either.
data_description.wind_position: Empty = not affected. E.g. 100 % retracts external venetian blinds. Only with the weather protection of the window on.
data_description.window_wind_threshold: Empty = wind protection from the threshold of the basic settings. Otherwise this window is protected already or only from this value (unit of the wind sensor).
data_description.rain_position: Empty = not affected. E.g. 0 % for a roof window shutter.
data_description.frost_position: Empty = off. With frost, closing stops at this position so the cover cannot freeze on, e.g. 5 %.
data_description.protection_keep_closed: A cover already further closed than its position with wind or rain is not opened to it (e.g. closed at 0 % with a wind position of 20 %). Not for a position of 100 %: retracting external venetian blinds always runs.
data_description.lockout_protection: While the contact reports open, nothing closes below the ventilation position, also not with the window exception or the weather protection.

morning.title: Morning opening
morning.description: Never with an active override, an opening block or a cover moved by hand since the evening. During vacation the simulation opens instead.

data.morning_sun_position: Directly to sun protection if needed

data_description.morning_latest: If nothing triggered until then, the cover opens at this time.
data_description.morning_sun_position: If the sun condition applies, open only to the sun protection position.
data_description.morning_enabled: Open the cover automatically in the morning.
data_description.morning_mode: What starts the morning opening; its settings follow in the next step.
data_description.morning_earliest: The cover never opens before this time, even if the trigger comes earlier.

data_description.morning_time_workday: Time on workdays (workday sensor or weekend days).
data_description.morning_time_weekend: Time on weekends and public holidays (holidays only with a workday sensor).

data_description.morning_sun_elevation: Only for sun elevation: opens when the rising sun passes this elevation.
data_description.morning_sun_event: Sunrise or the sun reaching an elevation.
data_description.morning_sun_offset: Minutes before (negative) or after the event.

data_description.morning_lux_threshold: Every brightness sensor of the group must reach this value.
data_description.morning_lux_hold: It must be bright enough this long before the cover opens.

data_description.morning_trigger_entity: A timestamp (e.g. the next alarm of a phone) opens at that time plus offset. Any other entity opens when it turns on (motion, switch).

reconfigure.title: Change window
reconfigure.description: What do you want to change? Each category is saved on its own.

menu_options.sun: Sun protection: thresholds, hold times, position, auto up
menu_options.behavior: Behaviour: override, additional conditions, evening, ventilation, vacation

user.title: New meter
user.description: Name and type. The type sets suitable defaults in the next step.

details.title: {name}
details.description: Camera, display and schedule of the meter.

camera_section.name: Camera and light
camera_section.description: Camera of the meter and the light that is switched on for the picture.

data_description.camera: Camera entity pointed at the display (e.g. an ESP32-CAM with ESPHome).
data_description.light: Optional. Switched on for the picture and off again afterwards (e.g. the flash LED).
data_description.light_brightness: Brightness of the light for the picture. Try it with a test picture: reflections make the display unreadable.
data_description.light_brightness_2: Optional (0 = off): each attempt also takes a second picture with this brightness, and the AI gets both. Helps when at one brightness a light spot outshines digits and at the other digits are too dark. An attempt takes longer.
data_description.warmup: Wait after switching the light on, so the camera adjusts its exposure.
data_description.discard_frames: Pictures thrown away before the real one. Cameras with a buffer (ESP32-CAM) otherwise deliver an old picture without light.

external_light_section.name: External light
external_light_section.description: Optional extra light (light or switch entity) besides the light of the camera, e.g. LED modules. When it cannot be reached, the meter is read without it and a warning is logged.

data_description.external_light: Optional. Light or switch entity that lights the display in addition. Leave empty when there is none.
data_description.external_light_mode: Only while taking pictures: switched on before the pictures and off afterwards. Always on: only switched on when it is off, and left on.
data_description.external_light_brightness: Only for a light entity that can be dimmed; a switch is just switched on and off.
data_description.external_light_lead_time: Wait after switching the external light on, before the light of the camera is switched on and the pictures are taken.
data_description.external_light_turn_off: Only in the mode "Only while taking pictures": switches the light off after the pictures, also when taking or reading them fails.

image_section.name: Picture crop
image_section.description: Only this part of the picture is sent to the AI. Crop wide-angle cameras to the display; in the dashboard the crop can be drawn with the mouse.

data_description.crop_left: Left edge of the crop in percent of the width of the turned picture.
data_description.crop_top: Top edge of the crop in percent of the height of the turned picture.
data_description.crop_right: Right edge of the crop in percent of the width of the turned picture.
data_description.crop_bottom: Bottom edge of the crop in percent of the height of the turned picture.
data_description.rotate: Turns the picture clockwise by this angle (negative: counterclockwise), e.g. 90 for a camera mounted sideways or a few degrees for a display that sits askew. Turned before cropping, the crop refers to the turned picture.
data_description.exposure: Brightness of the picture for the AI: 100 % leaves it unchanged, below is darker (against reflections and overexposure), above is brighter.
data_description.enhance: Turns the picture grey, evens out the lighting and stretches the contrast before the AI reads it. Helps when the light leaves a bright spot on the display glass and dark corners, or with pale LCD segments. Not shown in the live picture; take a test picture to see it.

display_section.name: Display
display_section.description: What the display shows. The hints are passed on to the AI.

data_description.unit: Unit shown on the display (e.g. MWh, kWh or m³).
data_description.decimals: Number of decimals shown on the display.
data_description.hints: Optional. What is special about this display, e.g. lines that are not part of a digit, or which digits to ignore.
data_description.prompt: Replace the whole generated instructions (leave empty for the standard). Unit, decimals and hints are then no longer inserted. The AI should still answer only with the number or “unreadable”.

schedule_section.name: Schedule
schedule_section.description: How often the meter is read automatically.

data.interval_off: Interval while the condition is off

data_description.condition_entity: Optional. While this entity is 'off', the second interval applies (e.g. a heating day sensor).
data_description.interval_off: Only used together with a condition.

checks_section.name: Checks
checks_section.description: Majority vote and plausibility check of a reading.

data_description.max_rate: In the meter unit. A larger increase since the last valid reading is rejected (e.g. 0.05 MWh = 50 kW).
data_description.max_correction: In the meter unit. A smaller value than before is only taken when it is at most this much lower and confirmed by further pictures.
data_description.max_attempts: Most pictures until a value has been read twice.
data_description.confirmations: Further pictures that must all show a smaller value before it is taken as a correction.
data_description.history_hint: The AI gets the last 3 valid readings as a hint, to decide an unclear digit plausibly. It should still read only what the picture shows; the checks here stay in place. Can tempt the AI to name an expected value, so use it mainly for displays that are hard to read.
data_description.meter_ai_task_entity: Optional. Instead of the AI task of the integration.

notify_section.name: Notifications
notify_section.description: From the how-many-th time in a row a notification appears in Home Assistant (0 = never, 1 = at once). A valid reading starts the count again. Only while notifications are switched on in the settings of the integration.

data_description.notify_smaller: Value below the last valid one and not confirmed as a correction (rejected).
data_description.notify_too_large: Value rose more than the largest increase per hour allows (rejected).
data_description.notify_corrected: Smaller value confirmed by more pictures and taken.
data_description.notify_failed: The AI reads nothing clear, or the camera or AI is not reachable. Unreadable readings do not interrupt the count of the other cases.

camera_section.name: Camera and light
camera_section.description: Camera of the meter and the light that is switched on for the picture.

data_description.camera: Camera entity pointed at the display (e.g. an ESP32-CAM with ESPHome).
data_description.light: Optional. Switched on for the picture and off again afterwards (e.g. the flash LED).
data_description.light_brightness: Brightness of the light for the picture. Try it with a test picture: reflections make the display unreadable.
data_description.light_brightness_2: Optional (0 = off): each attempt also takes a second picture with this brightness, and the AI gets both. Helps when at one brightness a light spot outshines digits and at the other digits are too dark. An attempt takes longer.
data_description.warmup: Wait after switching the light on, so the camera adjusts its exposure.
data_description.discard_frames: Pictures thrown away before the real one. Cameras with a buffer (ESP32-CAM) otherwise deliver an old picture without light.

external_light_section.name: External light
external_light_section.description: Optional extra light (light or switch entity) besides the light of the camera, e.g. LED modules. When it cannot be reached, the meter is read without it and a warning is logged.

data_description.external_light: Optional. Light or switch entity that lights the display in addition. Leave empty when there is none.
data_description.external_light_mode: Only while taking pictures: switched on before the pictures and off afterwards. Always on: only switched on when it is off, and left on.
data_description.external_light_brightness: Only for a light entity that can be dimmed; a switch is just switched on and off.
data_description.external_light_lead_time: Wait after switching the external light on, before the light of the camera is switched on and the pictures are taken.
data_description.external_light_turn_off: Only in the mode "Only while taking pictures": switches the light off after the pictures, also when taking or reading them fails.

image_section.name: Picture crop
image_section.description: Only this part of the picture is sent to the AI. Crop wide-angle cameras to the display; in the dashboard the crop can be drawn with the mouse.

data_description.crop_left: Left edge of the crop in percent of the width of the turned picture.
data_description.crop_top: Top edge of the crop in percent of the height of the turned picture.
data_description.crop_right: Right edge of the crop in percent of the width of the turned picture.
data_description.crop_bottom: Bottom edge of the crop in percent of the height of the turned picture.
data_description.rotate: Turns the picture clockwise by this angle (negative: counterclockwise), e.g. 90 for a camera mounted sideways or a few degrees for a display that sits askew. Turned before cropping, the crop refers to the turned picture.
data_description.exposure: Brightness of the picture for the AI: 100 % leaves it unchanged, below is darker (against reflections and overexposure), above is brighter.
data_description.enhance: Turns the picture grey, evens out the lighting and stretches the contrast before the AI reads it. Helps when the light leaves a bright spot on the display glass and dark corners, or with pale LCD segments. Not shown in the live picture; take a test picture to see it.

display_section.name: Display
display_section.description: What the display shows. The hints are passed on to the AI.

data_description.unit: Unit shown on the display (e.g. MWh, kWh or m³).
data_description.decimals: Number of decimals shown on the display.
data_description.hints: Optional. What is special about this display, e.g. lines that are not part of a digit, or which digits to ignore.
data_description.prompt: Replace the whole generated instructions (leave empty for the standard). Unit, decimals and hints are then no longer inserted. The AI should still answer only with the number or “unreadable”.

schedule_section.name: Schedule
schedule_section.description: How often the meter is read automatically.

data.interval_off: Interval while the condition is off

data_description.condition_entity: Optional. While this entity is 'off', the second interval applies (e.g. a heating day sensor).
data_description.interval_off: Only used together with a condition.

checks_section.name: Checks
checks_section.description: Majority vote and plausibility check of a reading.

data_description.max_rate: In the meter unit. A larger increase since the last valid reading is rejected (e.g. 0.05 MWh = 50 kW).
data_description.max_correction: In the meter unit. A smaller value than before is only taken when it is at most this much lower and confirmed by further pictures.
data_description.max_attempts: Most pictures until a value has been read twice.
data_description.confirmations: Further pictures that must all show a smaller value before it is taken as a correction.
data_description.history_hint: The AI gets the last 3 valid readings as a hint, to decide an unclear digit plausibly. It should still read only what the picture shows; the checks here stay in place. Can tempt the AI to name an expected value, so use it mainly for displays that are hard to read.
data_description.meter_ai_task_entity: Optional. Instead of the AI task of the integration.

notify_section.name: Notifications
notify_section.description: From the how-many-th time in a row a notification appears in Home Assistant (0 = never, 1 = at once). A valid reading starts the count again. Only while notifications are switched on in the settings of the integration.

data_description.notify_smaller: Value below the last valid one and not confirmed as a correction (rejected).
data_description.notify_too_large: Value rose more than the largest increase per hour allows (rejected).
data_description.notify_corrected: Smaller value confirmed by more pictures and taken.
data_description.notify_failed: The AI reads nothing clear, or the camera or AI is not reachable. Unreadable readings do not interrupt the count of the other cases.

options.movement: Only when the cover really moves
options.command: With every command by hand, also without movement

no_meter.message: {entity_id} does not belong to a meter of House Assistant.

negative.message: The meter reading must not be negative.

unknown_cover.message: {entity_id} does not belong to a window of House Assistant.

read_meter.name: Read meter
read_meter.description: Reads the meters of the given entities now (with majority vote and plausibility check).

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Any entity of the meter (e.g. its meter reading).

set_meter_reading.name: Set meter reading
set_meter_reading.description: Sets the meter reading by hand, e.g. after a wrong reading. The next readings are checked against this value.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Any entity of the meter (e.g. its meter reading).

value.name: Value
value.description: New meter reading in the unit of the meter.

move_cover.name: Move
move_cover.description: Moves windows of House Assistant without starting an override. Frost and the lockout protection still apply.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers of configured windows. Empty = all windows.

action.name: Action
action.description: Evening and sun protection use the positions of the window and are remembered like the automatic's own runs.

start_cover_override.name: Start override
start_cover_override.description: Pauses the automatic of windows like a manual movement.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers of configured windows. Empty = all windows.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Empty = the duration of the window. 0 = until sunrise.

end_cover_override.name: End override
end_cover_override.description: Ends a running override; the automatic decides at its next occasion.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers of configured windows. Empty = all windows.

resume_cover.name: Resume automatic
resume_cover.description: Ends an override and lets the automatic decide right away (sun protection, evening run).

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers of configured windows. Empty = all windows.

missing_group.title: Group of a window is missing
missing_group.description: The window {window} refers to a deleted group and has no sun protection. Choose a group in the settings of the window.

forecast_unsupported.title: Weather entity provides no forecast
forecast_unsupported.description: {weather} supports none of the forecast kinds daily, twice daily or hourly. The summer day then only starts by the outdoor temperature. Choose another weather entity in the settings of House Assistant.
